title: S0423 (123rd General Assembly): Weapons on school property

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2019-01-24; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess123_2019-2020/prever/423_20190124.htm (LegiScan doc 1869866))
provenance.note: Introduced Jan. 24, 2019. No passage vote. The bill title says possess 'on or within 1,000 feet'; the printed text adds 'or discharge a firearm within one thousand feet of'.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (Section 16-23-420(A)): It is unlawful for a person to possess a firearm of any kind on or discharge a firearm within one thousand feet of any premises or property owned, operated, or controlled by a private or public school, college, university, technical college, other post-secondary institution, or in any publicly owned building, without the express permission of the authorities in charge of the premises or property.
